input.quote: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created specifically for Customer (as defined in 1.4) and leaves us only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term. That fails the preferred position (Customer ownership with Vendor assignment) and also fails the fallback, which requires at minimum a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify Deliverables. Section 14.1 (Customer Data and pre-existing IP) and 14.4 (no joint ownership) are compliant, and 13.2/14.3 give a perpetual paid-up licence to embedded Vendor Technology — but that licence expressly covers Vendor Technology, not the Deliverable itself, so it does not cure 14.2 and in fact sits in tension with it. Redline flips ownership to Customer with an express assignment while preserving Vendor's retained Vendor Technology rights under 14.3.

proposal.summary: Flip Deliverable ownership to Customer with assignment; Vendor Technology carve-out preserved under 14.3
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own what we pay for, so we have flipped ownership of Deliverables created specifically for us to Customer with an assignment from Vendor; a revocable, term-limited licence is not acceptable. Vendor keeps its pre-existing Vendor Technology under Section 14.3 and the perpetual licence in Section 13.2. If Vendor must retain title, our fallback is Vendor ownership of generic tools plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable licence to use and modify Deliverables for our business.

ops.oldText: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest in and to each Deliverable upon its creation. Vendor's retained rights in Vendor Technology are governed by Section 14.3.
